observe: GET /api/health -> database:up AND a LOW uptime; a high uptime means an orphaned sibling-project server answered on :3100 (false green) - kill it and restart
GET / -> 200; body carries the site name and the primary CTA
for every slug exported from apps/web/src/content/offerings/index.ts: GET /services/<slug> -> 200 with the offering title; GET /services/does-not-exist -> not-found UI
submit the contact form (Playwright or the Server Action directly) -> a leads row in ai_consulting on aic-postgres -> the notification send is logged (keyless Resend = logged no-op)
GET /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt -> every public URL present; no auth/admin routes listed
verify.notes: Root .env is loaded by the start script's dotenv wrapper. DATABASE_URL must point at aic-postgres (host :5434, db ai_consulting) - never the template's :5432 appdb. Use the no-`--` form of `run`: `pnpm --filter web start -- --port 3100` forwards `--` literally and `next start` then reads `--port` as the project directory (verified in the template 2026-09-02). FREE :3100 BEFORE STARTING (see observe[0]). Marketing routes carry no auth; auth origin checks are exact - send an Origin header matching the served URL when driving /login or /admin.
